# Code Group

Switch between npm and pnpm command examples. This live example uses the canonical MoyaForge UI source and is rendered by the playground's MDX provider.

## Installation

Install the `code-group` component from the MoyaForge component registry. The selected source and CSS are copied into your application; they are not included in the framework package.

[Browse all UI components](/ui)

The directive mapping is configured through `createMdxOptions({ directiveComponents: { "code-group": { component: "CodeGroup", childType: "tab", childComponent: "CodeTab" } } })`. Renderers can be replaced through `MDXProvider` without changing the Markdown.

## Usage

```tsx
<CodeGroup label="Package managers">
  <CodeTab label="npm">
    <pre>npm install my-package</pre>
  </CodeTab>
  <CodeTab label="pnpm">
    <pre>pnpm add my-package</pre>
  </CodeTab>
</CodeGroup>
```

## Examples

### Default

The playground maps `code-group` and nested `tab` directives to the reusable React `CodeGroup` and `CodeTab` components.

:::: code-group Package managers

::: tab npm

```bash
npm install example-package
```

:::

::: tab pnpm

```bash
pnpm add example-package
```

:::

::::

## Styling

The installed component includes its source-owned CSS. Customize its styles in your application using scoped CSS selectors or the component's documented CSS variables. The example preview frame can be customized separately with `--mf-preview-border` and `--mf-preview-radius`.
